verses.text: For the one directing. A Psalm of David. May YHWH answer you in the day of distress; may the name of the God of Jacob set you on high.

segments.text: For the one directing. A Psalm of David. May YHWH answer you in the day of distress; may the name of the God of Jacob set you on high.

verses.text: May He send help for you from the Holy Place, and from Zion may He support you.

segments.text: May He send help for you from the Holy Place, and from Zion may He support you.

verses.text: May He remember all your gifts, and anoint your burnt offering. Selah

segments.text: May He remember all your gifts, and anoint your burnt offering. Selah

verses.text: may He give to you according to your heart, and fulfill all your counsel.

segments.text: may He give to you according to your heart, and fulfill all your counsel.

verses.text: We will rejoice in your salvation, and we will raise a banner in the name of our God; may YHWH fulfill all your petitions.

segments.text: We will rejoice in your salvation, and we will raise a banner in the name of our God; may YHWH fulfill all your petitions.

verses.text: Now I know that YHWH brings salvation [for] His anointed; He will answer him from His holy heaven, with the saving might of His right hand.

segments.text: Now I know that YHWH brings salvation [for] His anointed; He will answer him from His holy heaven, with the saving might of His right hand.

verses.text: These in the chariots, and these in the horses, but we, in the name of YHWH our God, will remember.

segments.text: These in the chariots, and these in the horses, but we, in the name of YHWH our God, will remember.

verses.text: They have bowed down and fallen, and we have risen and stand upright.

segments.text: They have bowed down and fallen, and we have risen and stand upright.

verses.text: O YHWH, save the king! Answer us on the day we call.

segments.text: O YHWH, save the king! Answer us on the day we call.
